questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

His father was killed in a ________, when the boy was nine years old.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e. **'duel'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, the appropriate word to fill the blank is **'duel',** which refers to a contest with deadly weapons arranged between two people in order to settle a point of honor. 
 
• It is the **only option** that fits the context of a fatal event.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *His father was killed in a** duel,** when the boy was nine years old.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Dwell'** means to live in a specified place, which doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• **'Drool' **means to salivate excessively, not appropriate here.
 
• **'Dual'** means consisting of two parts, elements, or aspects, which doesn't fit in this context.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the context **of this passage, we're discussing the effects of a malignant tumor in Terry Fox's right leg. 
 
• It mentions that it "resulted in (4) ________." Considering the story of Terry Fox, a Canadian athlete, humanitarian, and cancer research activist, we know that his right leg was amputated due to cancer. 
 
• Therefore, the correct word to complete the sentence is **"amputation,**" which is the process of removing a body extremity by trauma, prolonged constriction, or surgery.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Fragmentation" **(Option 1) refers to the process or state of breaking or being broken into small or separate parts. It doesn't fit the context of this sentence, as it's not a procedure or consequence typically associated with cancer treatment.
 
• **"Vasodilation" **(Option 3) is the widening of blood vessels. It results from relaxation of smooth muscle cells within the vessel walls, particularly in the large arteries, smaller arterioles and large veins. It's not suitable in this context as it doesn't relate to the consequences of a malignant tumor in a leg.
 
• **"Implantation"** (Option 4) is a procedure that inserts something into the body, such as a medical device. In this context, it's not a suitable term because it doesn't fit the known story of Terry Fox, who had his leg amputated due to cancer, not implanted.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1',** i.e.** "unveiling"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is about the events that took place on Monday at Simon Fraser University to mark the 25th anniversary of the run.
 
• Considering the context, it's logical to conclude that the event being held on Monday is the "unveiling" of the one-dollar commemorative circulation coin by the Royal Canadian Mint.
 
• **"Unveiling"** is the act of removing a veil or cover from something, often used metaphorically to refer to the presentation or introduction of a new product or initiative.
 
• Thus, **"unveiling"** fits well in the context of the sentence, as it implies the presentation of the commemorative coin.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Countervailing"** (Option 2) is a term often used in economic contexts to refer to counteracting or offsetting an effect by contrary action. In this context, it doesn't make sense as there's no suggestion of any counteraction in the sentence.
 
• **"Reconciling" **(Option 3) means to make compatible, harmonize, or resolve conflicts. It doesn't fit in the context of the sentence because the unveiling of a commemorative coin doesn't involve any form of reconciliation.
 
• **"Veiling" **(Option 4) is the act of covering something with a veil or something that functions as a veil. In this context, it's the opposite of what we want to express. The event is about unveiling or revealing something new, not hiding or covering it.
